text: All tests pass and the issue case is fixed. The change was a one-liner in `flags/parse.py`: `text.lower()` → `text.strip().lower()`, so `"off "` (and any surrounding whitespace) now correctly parses as `False`, matching the documented behavior. Whitespace-only input also now correctly raises `ValueError`.
